examples.text: tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako, veyyākaraṇo, lok'āyata-mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.
yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ iruvedaṃ yajuvedaṃ sāmavedaṃ athabbaṇavedaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ iti'h'āsaṃ purāṇaṃ nighaṇḍu keṭubhaṃ… sikkhā karaṇīyā

13502.meaning1: with legendary tales as the fifth
13502.commentary: (MNa) itihāsapañcamānan'ti āthabbaṇavedaṃ catutthaṃ katvā, itiha āsa itiha āsā'ti īdisavacanappaṭisaṃyutto purāṇakathāsaṅkhāto itihāso pañcamo etesan'ti

examples.text: tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako, veyyākaraṇo, lok'āyata-mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.

13503.meaning1: hearsay; according to tradition; saying the same old stuff again
13503.commentary: (MNa) itih'itiha param'parāyā'ti evaṃ kira evaṃ kirā'ti param'parabhāvena āgatan'ti dīpeti.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, sandaka, idh'ekacco satthā anussaviko hoti anussavasacco. so anussavena itih'itihaparam'parāya piṭakasampadāya dhammaṃ deseti. anussavikassa kho pana, sandaka, satthuno anussavasaccassa sussutam'pi hoti dussutam'pi hoti tathā'pi hoti aññathā'pi hoti.

13504.meaning1: lineage of oral repetition; succession of tradition
13504.commentary: (MNa) itih'itiha param'parāyā'ti evaṃ kira evaṃ kirā'ti param'parabhāvena āgatan'ti dīpeti.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, sandaka, idh'ekacco satthā anussaviko hoti anussavasacco. so anussavena itih'itihaparam'parāya piṭakasampadāya dhammaṃ deseti. anussavikassa kho pana, sandaka, satthuno anussavasaccassa sussutam'pi hoti dussutam'pi hoti tathā'pi hoti aññathā'pi hoti.

13505.meaning1: hearsay; according to tradition; saying the same old stuff again
13505.commentary: (SNa) na y'idaṃ itih'ītihan'ti idaṃ itiha itihā'ti na takkahetu vā nayahetu vā piṭakasampadānena vā ahaṃ vadāmi.

examples.text: ye me pubbe viyākaṃsu, huraṃ gotamasāsanā, icc'āsi iti bhavissati, sabbaṃ taṃ itih'ītihaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ takkavaḍḍhanaṃ, n'āhaṃ tattha abhiramiṃ.
itih'etaṃ vijānāma, aññaṃ pucchāma gotama, ye'dha laddhā manussattaṃ, vadaññū vītamaccharā.

tāni ce sutte osāriyamānāni vinaye sandassiyamānāni na c'eva sutte osaranti, na ca vinaye sandissanti, niṭṭham'ettha gantabbaṃ, addhā, idaṃ na c'eva tassa bhagavato vacanaṃ, imassa ca bhikkhuno duggahitan'ti. itih'etaṃ, bhikkhave, chaḍḍeyyātha.

13507.meaning1: this way and that; here and there

examples.text: bodhisatto ito c'ito ca olokento kañci adisvā vegena uṭṭhāya pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ān'āpāne pariggahetvā paṭhamajjhānaṃ nibbattesi.
apehi dubbinīte, na tvaṃ amhākaṃ ayyāya pakkuthitaṃ sappiṃ āsiñcituṃ anucchavikā'ti, santajjentiyo ito c'ito ca uṭṭhāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca pothetvā bhūmiyaṃ pātesuṃ.

13508.meaning2: from here and there; here and there

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, na dān'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, ito paraṃ uposathaṃ karissāmi, pātimokkhaṃ uddisissāmi

13512.meaning1: before now; ever before; from before then

examples.text: na me diṭṭho ito pubbe, na suto uda kassaci, evaṃ vagguvado satthā, tusitā gaṇim'āgato.
purimā, bhikkhave, koṭi na paññāyati avijjāya, ito pubbe avijjā n'āhosi, atha pacchā samabhavī'ti. evañ'c'etaṃ, bhikkhave, vuccati, atha ca pana paññāyati, idappaccayā avijjā'ti

so evaṃ pajānāti, yathārūpāy'āhaṃ diṭṭhiyā samannāgato, n'atthi ito bahiddhā añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā tathārūpāya diṭṭhiyā samannāgato'ti. idam'assa tatiyaṃ ñāṇaṃ adhigataṃ hoti ariyaṃ lok'uttaraṃ asādhāraṇaṃ puthujjanehi.
ito bahiddhā pāsaṇḍā, diṭṭhiyo upanissitā, na te dhammaṃ vijānanti, na te dhammassa kovidā.
n'āhaṃ taṃ, bhikkhave, passāmi… yo imesaṃ pañhānaṃ veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheyya, aññatra tathāgatena vā tathāgatasāvakena vā ito vā pana sutvā.
aññaṃ ito y'ābhivadanti dhammaṃ, aparaddhā suddhim'akevalī te, evam'pi titthyā puthuso vadanti, sandiṭṭhirāgena hi te'bhirattā.

13515.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of ima
13515.commentary: (SNPa) sutvāna nāgassa apanamissanti ito'ti nāgassa tava bhagavā vacanaṃ sutvā ito pāsāṇakacetiyato bahū janā pakkamissantī'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: okañ'jahaṃ taṇhacchidaṃ anejaṃ, nandiñ'jahaṃ oghatiṇṇaṃ vimuttaṃ, kappañ'jahaṃ abhiyāce sumedhaṃ, sutvāna nāgassa apanamissanti ito.

13516.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of ima
13516.meaning1: (of time) from here; from now; after

examples.text: purimā, bhikkhave, koṭi na paññāyati avijjāya, ito pubbe avijjā n'āhosi, atha pacchā samabhavī'ti
aparimeyy'ito kappe, caturo āsuṃ vināyakā, taṇhaṅ'karo medhaṅ'karo, atho'pi saraṇaṅ'karo, dīpaṅ'karo ca sambuddho, ekakappamhi te jinā.

13517.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of ima

examples.text: diṭṭhiñ'ca nissāya anupucchamāno, samuggahītesu pamoham'āgā, ito ca n'āddakkhi aṇum'pi saññaṃ, tasmā tuvaṃ momuhato dahāsi.

13518.meaning1: this way and that; here and there

13519.meaning1: born from this; sprung from here

examples.text: rāgo ca doso ca itonidānā, aratī ratī lomahaṃso itojā, ito samuṭṭhāya manovitakkā, kumārakā dhaṅkamivossajanti.

13520.meaning1: because of this; for this reason
13520.commentary: (SNa) itonidānā'ti ayaṃ attabhāvo nidānaṃ etesan'ti ito nidānā.

13521.meaning1: from this source; because of this

examples.text: chandānidānāni piyāni loke, ye c'āpi lobhā vicaranti loke, āsā ca niṭṭhā ca itonidānā, ye samparāyāya narassa honti.

13523.meaning1: arising from this; originating from this; due to this; based on this
13523.commentary: (MNa) itosamuṭṭhānā'ti ito sarāg'ādicittato samuṭṭhānaṃ uppatti etesan'ti itosamuṭṭhānā.

examples.text: itosamuṭṭhānā akusalā sīlā, tam'ahaṃ, thapati, veditabban'ti vadāmi. idha akusalā sīlā aparisesā nirujjhanti, tam'ahaṃ, thapati, veditabban'ti vadāmi.
supinak'ūpamā kāmā ittara-paccupaṭṭhān'aṭṭhenā'ti passanto vikkhambhanato kāme parivajjeti

13525.commentary: (SNa) tañ'ca kho dīghena addhunā na ittaran'ti tañ'ca sīlaṃ dīghena kālena veditabbaṃ, na ittarena. dvī'ha-tī'hañ'hi saṃyatākāro ca saṃvut'indriyākāro ca na sakkā dassetuṃ. (PVa) ittaran'ti na cirakālaṭṭhāyī, aniccaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ. ittaraṃ idha jīvitan'ti idha manussaloke sattānaṃ jīvitam'pi ittaraṃ parittaṃ appakaṃ. ten'āha bhagavā, yo ciraṃ jīvati, so vassasataṃ appaṃ vā bhiyyo'ti (dī. ni. 2.91, saṃ. ni. 1.145, a. ni. 7.74). ittaraṃ ittarato ñatvā'ti dhanadhaññādiupakaraṇaṃ manussānaṃ jīvitañ'ca ittaraṃ parittaṃ khaṇikaṃ na cirassan'ti paññāya upaparikkhitvā.

examples.text: yena yena hi maññanti, tato taṃ hoti aññathā, tañ'hi tassa musā hoti, mosadhammañ'hi ittaraṃ.

yato naṃ samannesamāno evaṃ jānāti, ye vodātā cakkhusotaviññeyyā dhammā, saṃvijjanti te tathāgatassā'ti, tato naṃ uttariṃ samannesati, dīgharattaṃ samāpanno ayam'āyasmā imaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ, udāhu ittarasamāpanno'ti?

13529.meaning1: of low birth; of an inferior class
13529.commentary: (MNa) ittarajacco'ti aññajātiko, mayā saddhiṃ asamānajātiko, lāmakajātiko'ti attho.

examples.text: atha kho, ānanda, jotipālassa māṇavassa etadahosi, acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho! yatra hi nām'āyaṃ ghaṭikāro kumbhakāro ittarajacco samāno amhākaṃ sīsaṃnhātānaṃ kesesu parāmasitabbaṃ maññissati

13530.meaning1: quick look; brief appraisal; cursory glance

examples.text: na vaṇṇarūpena naro sujāno, na vissase ittaradassanena, susaññatānañ'hi viyañjanena, asaññatā lokam'imaṃ caranti.

13531.meaning1: having a short-lived liking; with a brief fondness

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, puggalo lolo hoti? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo ittarasaddho hoti ittarabhattī ittarapemo ittarappasādo. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo lolo hoti.

13532.meaning1: having short-lived trust; with brief confidence

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, puggalo lolo hoti? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo ittarasaddho hoti ittarabhattī ittarapemo ittarappasādo. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo lolo hoti.

13533.meaning1: having short-lived devotion; with brief adherence
13533.commentary: (ANt) ittarabhattī'ti-ādīsu punappunaṃ bhajanena saddhā'va bhattipemaṃ. saddhāpemam'pi gehassitapemam'pi vaṭṭati, pasādo saddhāpasādo.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, puggalo lolo hoti? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo ittarasaddho hoti ittarabhattī ittarapemo ittarappasādo. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo lolo hoti.

13534.meaning1: having short-lived faith; with brief confidence

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, puggalo lolo hoti? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo ittarasaddho hoti ittarabhattī ittarapemo ittarappasādo. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo lolo hoti.

yato naṃ samannesamāno evaṃ jānāti, ye vodātā cakkhusotaviññeyyā dhammā, saṃvijjanti te tathāgatassā'ti, tato naṃ uttariṃ samannesati, dīgharattaṃ samāpanno ayam'āyasmā imaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ, udāhu ittarasamāpanno'ti?

13536.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of ittara
13536.meaning1: briefly; for a short time; momentarily
13536.commentary: (SNa) tañ'ca kho dīghena addhunā na ittaran'ti tañ'ca sīlaṃ dīghena kālena veditabbaṃ, na ittarena. dvī'ha-tī'hañ'hi saṃyatākāro ca saṃvut'indriyākāro ca na sakkā dassetuṃ.

examples.text: sākacchāya, kho, mahārāja, paññā veditabbā. sā ca kho dīghena addhunā, na ittaraṃ, manasikarotā, no amanasikarotā, paññavatā, no duppaññenā'ti.

13537.grammar: ind, adv, in comps, from ima
13537.notes: form taken by ettha in compounds

examples.text: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, n'āparaṃ itthattāyā'ti pajānāti.

13538.grammar: ind, adv, in comps, from ima

examples.text: asmī'ti, bhikkhave, sati itth'asmī'ti hoti, evaṃ'smī'ti hoti, aññathā'smī'ti hoti, as'asmī'ti hoti, sat'asmī'ti hoti, santi hoti, itthaṃ santi hoti, evaṃ santi hoti, aññathā santi hoti
phuṭṭho, bhikkhave, vedeti, phuṭṭho ceteti, phuṭṭho sañjānāti. itth'ete'pi dhammā calā c'eva byathā ca aniccā vipariṇāmino aññathābhāvino.

13539.meaning1: present state; existence here; such an existence
13539.commentary: (MNa) n'āparaṃ itthattāyā'ti idāni puna itthabhāvāya evaṃsoḷasakiccabhāvāya, kilesakkhayāya vā maggabhāvanākiccaṃ me n'atthī'ti abbhaññāsi. atha vā itthattāyā'ti itthabhāvato imasmā evaṃpakārā idāni vattamānakkhandhasantānā aparaṃ khandhasantānaṃ mayhaṃ n'atthi.

examples.text: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ n'āparaṃ itthattāyā'ti pajānāti
ye kec'ime isayo manujā, khattiyā brāhmaṇā devatānaṃ, yaññam'akappayiṃsu puthū'dha loke, āsīsamānā puṇṇaka itthattaṃ, jaraṃ sitā yaññam'akappayiṃsu.
itthatte, bhikkhave, abhiratā sattā purisesu saṃyogaṃ gatā. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, itthī itthattaṃ n'ātivattati.

13541.meaning1: called so-and-so; with such-and-such a name
13541.meaning2: one having such and such a name; called so-and-so; so and so; such and such

examples.text: suṇātu me, bhante, saṅgho. itthan'nāmo ca ittha'nāmo ca bhikkhū itthan'nāmassa bhikkhuno saṅghabhedāya parakkamantassa anuvattakā vaggavādakā. te taṃ vatthuṃ na paṭinissajjanti.

13542.meaning1: with a woman inside; (comm) with a female driver
13542.meaning2: with a woman inside; with a woman driver (?)

13543.meaning1: called so-and-so; with such-and-such a name
13543.meaning2: of such and such a name

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno codakass'eva paccāropeti, tvaṃ kho'si itthan'nāmaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno, tvaṃ tāva paṭhamaṃ paṭikarohī'ti.

atha kho aññatarā bhikkhunī aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi, ehi tvaṃ, ambho purisa, yen'ayyo ānando ten'upasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena ayyassa ānandassa pāde sirasā vanda, itthan'nāmā, bhante, bhikkhunī ābādhikinī dukkhitā bāḷhagilānā.
sen'āsanaleso nāma itthan'nāmasen'āsanavāsiko diṭṭho hoti pārājikaṃ dhammaṃ ajjhāpajjanto.

13545.meaning1: present state of existence; earthly existence; such an existence
13545.commentary: (ANa) itthabhāv'aññathābhāvan'ti ettha itthabhāvo nāma ayaṃ attabhāvo, aññathābhāvo nāma anāgatattabhāvo.

examples.text: ye kec'ime isayo manujā, khattiyā brāhmaṇā devatānaṃ, yaññam'akappayiṃsu puthū'dha loke, āsīsamānā puṇṇaka itthabhāvaṃ, jaraṃ sitā yaññam'akappayiṃsu.
jātimaraṇasaṃsāraṃ, ye vajanti punappunaṃ, itthabhāv'aññathābhāvaṃ, avijjāy'eva sā gati.

13546.meaning1: this or another existence; existence here and there

examples.text: jātimaraṇasaṃsāraṃ, ye vajanti punappunaṃ, itthabhāv'aññathābhāvaṃ, avijjāy'eva sā gati.
taṇhādutiyo puriso, dīgham'addhāna saṃsaraṃ, itthabhāv'aññathābhāvaṃ, saṃsāraṃ n'ātivattati.

13547.meaning1: being thus; like this; being so

13549.meaning1: I am thus; I am like this
13549.commentary: (ANa) anupanidhāyā'ti aññaṃ ākāraṃ anupagamma sakabhāvam'eva ārammaṇaṃ katvā itth'asmī'ti hoti, khattiy'ādīsu idaṃpakāro ahan'ti evaṃ taṇhā-māna-diṭṭhi-vasena hotī'ti attho.

examples.text: asmī'ti, bhikkhave, sati itth'asmī'ti hoti, evaṃ'smī'ti hoti, aññathā'smī'ti hoti, as'asmī'ti hoti, sat'asmī'ti hoti, santi hoti, itthaṃ santi hoti, evaṃ santi hoti, aññathā santi hoti
itthaṃ sudaṃ bhagavā āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ imāhi gāthāhi abhiṇhaṃ ovadatī'ti
iminā cīvaracetāpannena cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā itthan'nāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarena acchādessāmī'ti

13553.commentary: (PYt) sabbaṃ itth'āgāran'ti sabbo orodho. so hi itthīnaṃ agāran'ti itth'āgāran'ti vuccati.
13553.notes: nt in grammar, fem in meaning

examples.text: atha kho maṃ, bhante, itthāgāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca, devassa kho dānaṃ dīyati, amhākaṃ dānaṃ na dīyati

13554.meaning1: longing for a woman; yearning for a female

examples.text: itthī, bhikkhave, puris'ādhippāyā appaṃ rattiyā supati, bahuṃ jaggati. puriso, bhikkhave, itth'ādhippāyo appaṃ rattiyā supati, bahuṃ jaggati. coro, bhikkhave, ādān'ādhippāyo appaṃ rattiyā supati, bahuṃ jaggati.

13555.commentary: (VIN) itth'ālaṅ'kāro nāma sīs'ūpago gīv'ūpago hatth'ūpago pād'ūpago kaṭ'ūpago.

examples.text: mal'itthiyā duccaritaṃ, maccheraṃ dadato malaṃ, malā ve pāpakā dhammā, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca.
satt'ime, bhikkhave, dhammā sapattakantā sapattakaraṇā kodhanaṃ āgacchanti itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā. katame satta?
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici kulāni bahu-itthikāni appapurisāni tāni suppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi.
itthikathaṃ sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānattakathaṃ lok'akkhāyikaṃ samudd'akkhāyikaṃ itibhav'ābhavakathaṃ iti vā.
gāmakathaṃ nigamakathaṃ nagarakathaṃ janapadakathaṃ itthikathaṃ sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ

13560.commentary: (VINa) itthikāya itthidhanan'ti hīḷento āha. itthikāya nāma itthiparibhogānaṃ'y'eva nhānacuṇṇ'ādīnaṃ atthāya laddhaṃ dhanaṃ kittakaṃ bhaveyya.

examples.text: dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yathā aññā itthikā nava vā dasa vā māse gabbhaṃ kucchinā pariharitvā vijāyanti, na h'evaṃ bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā vijāyati. das'eva māsāni bodhisattaṃ bodhisattamātā kucchinā pariharitvā vijāyati.
idaṃ te, tāta sudinna, mātu mattikaṃ, itthikāya itthidhanaṃ, aññaṃ pettikaṃ aññaṃ pitāmahaṃ.

13561.commentary: (SNa) itthikāmehī'ti itthīhi saddhiṃ kāmā itthikāmā, tehi itthikāmehi.

examples.text: tassa rājā attamano abhihārama'dāsi. ten'āyaṃ puriso mālī kuṇḍalī sunhāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu, itthikāmehi rājā maññe paricāretī'ti.

13562.meaning1: female behaviour; womanly style; woman's bearing; female ways
13562.meaning2: female contriving, feminine wiles; woman's ways

examples.text: itthī, bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ itth'indriyaṃ manasi karoti, itthikuttaṃ itth'ākappaṃ itthividhaṃ itthicchandaṃ itthissaraṃ itth'ālaṅ'kāraṃ. sā tattha rajjati tatr'ābhiramati.

13563.commentary: (MNa) itthikumārikapaṭiggahaṇā'ti ettha itthī'ti puris'antaragatā, itarā kumārikā nāma. tāsaṃ paṭiggahaṇam'pi āmasanam'pi akappiyam'eva.

examples.text: itthikumārikapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, dāsidāsapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, aj'eḷakapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, kukkuṭasūkarapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ

13564.meaning1: smell of a woman; female scent
13564.commentary: (ANa) itthigandho'ti itthiyā catusamuṭṭhānikaṃ gandh'āyatanaṃ. sv'āyaṃ itthiyā sarīragandho duggandho hoti, kāy'āruḷho pana āgantukaanulepan'ādigandho idha adhippeto. ekaccā hi itthī assagandhinī hoti, ekaccā meṇḍakagandhinī, ekaccā sedagandhinī, ekaccā soṇitagandhinī. ekacco andhabālo evarūpāyapi itthiyā rajjat'eva.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekagandham'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, itthigandho. itthigandho, bhikkhave, purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī'ti.

13565.commentary: (PVa) itthicittaṃ virājetvā'ti itthibhāve cittaṃ ajjhāsayaṃ abhiruciṃ virājetvā itthibhāve virattacittā hutvā.

examples.text: sā itthicittaṃ virājetvā purisattaṃ bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā.
mettācittaṃ ābhāvetvā, brahmalok'ūpapattiyā, itthicittaṃ virājetvā, brahmalok'ūpagā ahū'ti.

13567.meaning1: wanting a woman; in need of a female
13567.meaning2: who wants a woman; who is looking for a woman

examples.text: atha kho, ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imāsaṃ pokkharaṇīnaṃ tīre evarūpaṃ dānaṃ paṭṭhapeyyaṃ, annaṃ ann'aṭṭhikassa, pānaṃ pān'aṭṭhikassa, vatthaṃ vatth'aṭṭhikassa, yānaṃ yān'aṭṭhikassa, sayanaṃ sayan'aṭṭhikassa, itthiṃ itthi'ṭṭhikassa, hiraññaṃ hiraññ'aṭṭhikassa, suvaṇṇaṃ suvaṇṇ'aṭṭhikassā'ti.

13568.meaning1: fact of being female; femininity; female state
13568.commentary: (DNa) itthittaṃ virājetvā'ti itthittaṃ nāma alaṃ, na hi itthitte ṭhatvā cakkavattisiriṃ, na sakkamārabrahmasiriyo paccanubhavituṃ, na paccekabodhiṃ, na sammāsambodhiṃ gantuṃ sakkā'ti evaṃ itthittaṃ virājeti nāma. mahantamidaṃ purisattaṃ nāma seṭṭhaṃ uttamaṃ, ettha ṭhatvā sakkā etā sampattiyo pāpuṇitun'ti evaṃ pana purisattaṃ bhāveti nāma. sā'pi evam'akāsi. tena vuttaṃ, itthittaṃ virājetvā purisattaṃ bhāvetvā'ti.

examples.text: ahañ'hi nāma itthikā samānā buddhe pasannā dhamme pasannā saṅghe pasannā sīlesu paripūrakārinī itthittaṃ virājetvā purisattaṃ bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā, devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ sakkassa devānam'indassa puttattaṃ ajjhupagatā.

13569.commentary: (VINa) itthikāya itthidhanan'ti hīḷento āha. itthikāya nāma itthiparibhogānaṃ'y'eva nhānacuṇṇ'ādīnaṃ atthāya laddhaṃ dhanaṃ kittakaṃ bhaveyya.

examples.text: idaṃ te, tāta sudinna, mātu mattikaṃ, itthikāya itthidhanaṃ, aññaṃ pettikaṃ aññaṃ pitāmahaṃ.

13570.meaning1: Romeo; promiscuous man; who indulges in women

examples.text: itthidhutto surādhutto, akkhadhutto ca yo naro, laddhaṃ laddhaṃ vināseti, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

13572.commentary: (ADha) tattha itthibhāvalakkhaṇaṃ itth'indriyaṃ, itthī'ti pakāsanarasaṃ, itthiliṅga-nimitta-kutt'ākappānaṃ kāraṇabhāvapaccupaṭṭhānaṃ.

examples.text: bāvīsat'indriyāni, cakkhu'ndriyaṃ, sot'indriyaṃ, ghān'indriyaṃ, jivh'indriyaṃ, kāy'indriyaṃ, man'indriyaṃ, itth'indriyaṃ, puris'indriyaṃ

13574.meaning1: woman to be captured; women to be taken as wives

examples.text: bahū tattha hatthikāyā assakāyā rathakāyā pattikāyā, bahu tattha dhanadhaññaṃ, bahu tattha hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ akatañ'c'eva katañ'ca, bahu tattha itthipariggaho. sakkā ca tāvataken'eva balamattena abhivijinituṃ.

13575.meaning1: female and male; women and men
13575.meaning2: male and female; men and women
13575.commentary: (APt) itthiyaṃ pume c'āyaṃ, itthī ca pumā ca itthipumaṃ, tasmiṃ.

examples.text: na candimasūriyā paññāyanti, na nakkhattāni tārakarūpāni paññāyanti, na rattin'divā paññāyanti, na mās'aḍḍhamāsā paññāyanti, na utusaṃvaccharā paññāyanti, na itthipumā paññāyanti, sattā sattātveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchanti.

13576.meaning1: appearance of feminine and masculine gender

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, ayaṃ migāramātupāsādo suñño hatthigav'assavaḷavena, suñño jātarūparajatena, suñño itthipurisasannipātena atthi c'ev'idaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ, bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṭicca ekattaṃ

13578.meaning2: assuming (there to be) a man or woman, etc.

13579.meaning1: touch of a woman; female physical contact
13579.commentary: (ANa) itthiphoṭṭhabbo'ti itthiyā kāyasamphasso, itthisarīrāruḷhānaṃ vatth'ālaṅ'kāramāl'ādīnam'pi phasso itthiphoṭṭhabbo'tv'eva veditabbo. sabbo'p'esa purisassa cittaṃ pariyādiyati mahācetiyaṅgaṇe gaṇasajjhāyaṃ gaṇhantassa daharabhikkhuno visabhāg'ārammaṇaphasso viyā'ti.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekaphoṭṭhabbam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, itthiphoṭṭhabbo. itthiphoṭṭhabbo, bhikkhave, purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī'ti.

13580.meaning1: under the power of a woman's touch

examples.text: itthiphoṭṭhabbe, bhikkhave, sattā rattā giddhā gathitā mucchitā ajjhosannā. te dīgharattaṃ socanti itthiphoṭṭhabbavas'ānugā.

13581.meaning2: state of being a woman; femininity; birth, existence, as a woman
13581.commentary: (THIa) dukkho itthibhāvo akkhāto'ti capalatā, gabbhadhāraṇaṃ, sabbakālaṃ parapaṭibaddhavuttitā'ti evam'ādīhi ādīnavehi itthibhāvo dukkho'ti

examples.text: dukkho itthibhāvo, akkhāto purisadammasārathinā, sapattikam'pi hi dukkhaṃ, app'ekaccā sakiṃ vijātāyo.

13582.commentary: (VIN 1.2.5) purisassa vā itthimatin'ti itthiyā matiṃ purisassa āroceti.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu sañcarittaṃ samāpajjeyya itthiyā vā purisamatiṃ purisassa vā itthimatiṃ, jāyattane vā jārattane vā, antamaso taṅ'khaṇikāya'pi, saṅgh'ādiseso.

13584.meaning1: yoked by a woman; (comm) yoked with a female cow

13585.meaning1: woman treasure; consort of a universal ruler; one of the seven treasures of a universal ruler

examples.text: tass'imāni satta ratanāni bhavanti, seyyath'idaṃ, cakkaratanaṃ, hatthiratanaṃ, assaratanaṃ, maṇiratanaṃ, itthiratanaṃ, gahapatiratanaṃ, pariṇāyakaratanam'eva sattamaṃ.
imāni te, deva, caturāsīti itthisahassāni itthiratanappamukhāni.

13587.meaning1: taste of a woman; female flavour
13587.commentary: (ANa) itthiraso'ti itthiyā catusamuṭṭhānikaṃ ras'āyatanaṃ. tipiṭaka-cūḷanāga-cūḷābhayattherā pana sv'āyaṃ itthiyā kiṃkārapaṭissāvit'ādi-vasena savanaraso c'eva paribhogaraso ca, ayaṃ itthiraso'ti vadanti. kiṃ tena? yo pan'āyaṃ itthiyā oṭṭhamaṃsa-sammakkhana-kheḷ'ādi-raso'pi, sāmikassa dinnayāgubhatt'ādīnaṃ raso'pi, sabbo so itthiraso'tv'eva veditabbo. aneke hi sattā attano mātugāmena yaṃkiñci sahatthā dinnam'eva madhuran'ti gahetvā anayabyasanaṃ pattā'ti.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekarasam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, itthiraso. itthiraso, bhikkhave, purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī'ti. catutthaṃ.

13588.meaning1: feminine form; image of a woman

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, rajako vā cittakārako vā rajanāya vā lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjiṭṭhāya vā suparimaṭṭhe phalake vā bhittiyā vā dussapaṭṭe vā itthirūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhinimmineyya sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgiṃ.
pakkamissañ'ca nāḷāto, ko'dha nāḷāya vacchati, bandhantī itthirūpena, samaṇe dhammajīvino.

13589.meaning1: woman's physical appearance; feminine figure; (comm) womanly wiles
13589.commentary: (THIa) bandhantī itthirūpena, samaṇe dhammajīvino'ti cāpe tvaṃ dhammena jīvante dhammike pabbajite attano itthirūpena itthikutt'ākappehi bandhantī tiṭṭhasi. yen'āhaṃ idāni ediso jāto, tasmā taṃ pariccajāmī'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: pakkamissañ'ca nāḷāto, ko'dha nāḷāya vacchati, bandhantī itthirūpena, samaṇe dhammajīvino.

13591.meaning1: under the power of a woman's physical appearance

examples.text: itthirūpe, bhikkhave, sattā rattā giddhā gathitā mucchitā ajjhosannā. te dīgharattaṃ socanti itthirūpavas'ānugā.

13592.commentary: (DNa) itthilakkhaṇ'ādīni'pi yamhi kule te itthipuris'ādayo vasanti, tassa vuḍḍhihānivasen'eva veditabbāni.

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… usulakkhaṇaṃ dhanulakkhaṇaṃ āvudhalakkhaṇaṃ itthilakkhaṇaṃ purisalakkhaṇaṃ kumāralakkhaṇaṃ kumārilakkhaṇaṃ dāsalakkhaṇaṃ dāsilakkhaṇaṃ hatthilakkhaṇaṃ

13593.meaning2: female sexual organ; feminine sexual characteristics

examples.text: yathā yathā kho te, vāseṭṭha, sattā akaṭṭhapākaṃ sāliṃ paribhuñjantā taṃbhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu, tathā tathā tesaṃ sattānaṃ bhiyyosomattāya kharattañ'c'eva kāyasmiṃ okkami, vaṇṇavevaṇṇatā ca paññāyittha, itthiyā ca itthiliṅgaṃ pāturahosi purisassa ca purisaliṅgaṃ.

13595.meaningLit: by the power of the female gender

examples.text: tena samayena buddho bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭ'āgārasālāyan'ti ettha vesāliyan'ti evaṃnāmake itthiliṅgavasena pavattavohāre nagare.
rosikaṃ nhāpitaṃ āmantesī'ti rosikā'ti evaṃ itthiliṅgavasena laddhanāmaṃ nhāpitaṃ āmantesi.

13596.meaning1: greedy for girls; hungry for women

examples.text: atha kho, bho, te cha khattiyā ekam'antaṃ apakkamma evaṃ samacintesuṃ, ime kho brāhmaṇā nāma itthiluddhā, yaṃnūna mayaṃ mahāgovindaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ itthīhi sikkheyyāmā'ti.

13597.meaning1: perceiving as a woman; regarding as female
13597.commentary: (VINt) tattha itthisaññī'ti tadahujātāya'pi manussitthiyā itthisaññī'y'eva hutvā'ti attho.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena rañño utenassa uyyānagatassa antepuraṃ daḍḍhaṃ hoti, pañca ca itthisatāni kālaṅ'katāni honti sāmāvatīpamukhāni.

13599.meaning1: sound of a woman; female noise
13599.commentary: (ANa) tesu itthisaddo'ti itthiyā cittasamuṭṭhāno kathitagītavāditasaddo. apica itthiyā nivatthanivāsanassā'pi alaṅ'kat'ālaṅ'kārassā'pi itthipayoganipphādito vīṇāsaṅkhapaṇav'ādisaddo'pi itthisaddo'tv'eva veditabbo. sabbo'pi h'eso purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekasaddam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, itthisaddo. itthisaddo, bhikkhave, purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī'ti.
